To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.example.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.example.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.example.com>, Anna Lopez <anna@acme.com>, DevOps Team <devops@brighttech.io>, Sam Patel <sales@storix.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 Sep 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evening sprint: coordinated demo window + bridge roles

Hi all —

Thanks for engaging on the group demo. To keep this tight for your engineering teams we are proposing a single 40-minute evening sprint: 20m product demo + 10m security & deployment Q&A + 10m open troubleshooting.

Please reply with the single option that works best for your group (we'll hold others as standby):
- Option A: Tue Sep 19, 2028 — 17:30–18:10 PT / 20:30–21:10 ET
- Option B: Wed Sep 20, 2028 — 18:00–18:40 PT / 21:00–21:40 ET
- Option C: Thu Sep 21, 2028 — 16:00–16:40 PT / 19:00–19:40 ET (shorter for APAC)

Logistics notes:
- We'll run on a partner multipoint bridge (recording allowed) so we can pin the demo host + security panel. Sergio, can you confirm we have the bridge and recording enabled?
- Ben — can you bring the latest demo build (quantization/batching examples)?
- Neha — please prepare 5 slides on host/networking/KMS expectations.
- Lauren — will you send calendar invites once we lock the time?

Agenda and a short attendee list attached. If any customer needs an NDA before the session, flag it here.

Thanks — Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
